method: LIGHT pass (Tuesday). Re-read the fast-moving self-serve providers (RunPod, Nebius, Verda/DataCrunch, Lambda, Hyperstack, Together AI, CoreWeave, Crusoe, Voltage Park, TensorDock); the only provider with a 'changed' row in the last 7 days (Verda, 2026-11-01) is already in that set. Read on the seller's own pricing pages by WebFetch on 2026-11-03. Rows not attempted are omitted (incl. Verda long-term rows 91-98). Status: confirmed = same price read today; changed = different price read today; unavailable = offering absent from the reference page; not_rechecked = attempted but no readable/attributable USD price today (price untouched). Per-node prices divided by GPUs per node as noted.
